```python
import requests

    "x-apikey": api_key,
}

    f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}/dns",
    headers=headers,
)

    dns_data = response.json()
    print(dns_data)
else:
    print(f"Error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
```
